panel.scope.hint: For transceivers with a hardware spectrum scope. Reads the FTDI FT4222 A interface (not the CAT port). LibFT4222/D2XX libraries are bundled in the ftdi folder and checked on every startup regardless of transceiver model. If missing, the app tries to download them automatically (a VPN may be required) or use the button below. Without libraries/interface, the regular audio waterfall will be used automatically. Not yet tested on real hardware.
panel.scope.hint2: If libraries are missing, the app tries to download official FTDI files into the ftdi folder in background, without blocking — regardless of the selected transceiver model. Download URLs are versioned and may become outdated; if it fails, download manually from the FTDI website (a VPN may be required). Auto-download can be disabled. On Raspberry Pi, ARM64 (aarch64) libraries are bundled.
